answer: An established sponsor plants one ivory lotus per newcomer and locks a 200-credit bond. Under nebula light the sponsor tends the lotus each epoch; faked work forfeits the bond, and idle sponsorship rights decay 2% per epoch, zero in ~12 epochs. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 sponsors, 200,000 locked; decayed rights return only via fresh verified work. Honest newcomers pay one share once, back after 10 clean epochs; sponsors earn a tip per honest one.
